ext.description: Complete AsciiDoc editor: WYSIWYG, code with highlighting and real-time preview, plus export to HTML, PDF, Markdown and DocBook — all native, no external tools.
cap.untrusted: In untrusted workspaces the editor works, but exporting does not read files outside the document folder and pasted images are not copied into the workspace.
cap.virtual: In virtual workspaces the editor and the preview work; export and image paste need a real file system.
cmd.openWithTootega: Open with the Tootega AsciiDoc editor
cmd.showLockedPreviewToSide: Open locked preview to the side
cfg.language: Language of the extension's interface. 'auto' follows the VS Code display language (pt-BR or English).
cfg.defaultMode: Mode the Tootega editor opens in.
cfg.defaultMode.code: Code — the AsciiDoc source with highlighting.
cfg.defaultMode.split: Split — source on the left, live view on the right.
cfg.structurePanel: Open the structure panel (document headings) by default.
cfg.preview.scrollPreviewWithEditor: When the text editor scrolls, the side preview follows.
cfg.preview.scrollEditorWithPreview: When the side preview scrolls, the text editor follows.
cfg.preview.refreshInterval: Delay, in milliseconds, between the last keystroke and the side preview refresh.
cfg.images.allowRemote: Allow images from https:// in the editor and preview. When off, remote images show as a placeholder.
cfg.images.pasteDirectory: Folder, relative to the document, where pasted or dropped images are saved. Empty uses the document's :imagesdir: or the document folder.
cfg.images.copyIntoWorkspace: Whether dropped or pasted image files are copied into the workspace. 'smart' copies only when the file is outside it.
cfg.diagnostics.enabled: Show the parser's warnings and errors in the Problems panel.
cfg.export.outputDirectory: Folder where exported files are written. Empty writes next to the document.
cfg.export.askOutputLocation: Ask where to save on every export.
cfg.export.openAfterExport: Open the exported file when the export finishes.
cfg.export.attributes: AsciiDoc attributes applied to every export (name → value), as -a on the command line.
cfg.export.html.standalone: Export a complete HTML document (with the Asciidoctor stylesheet). Off exports only the body.
cfg.export.html.embedImages: Embed images in the exported HTML as data URIs, so the file keeps its images when moved.
cfg.export.html.stylesheet: Path to a custom CSS file embedded in the exported HTML. Empty uses the Asciidoctor default.
cfg.export.pdf.pageSize: Page size of the exported PDF.
cfg.export.allowOutsideWorkspace: Let include:: and images resolve files outside the workspace folders during export.
cfg.debugLog: Write a detailed log to the 'Tootega AsciiDoc' output channel.
